# Fetch content for all habit tracker notes and extract good posture status.
habit_data = []
for note_meta in all_notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_meta['note_id'], access_token=access_token)
    content = note['content']
    # Extract date from title
    date_str = note['title'].replace('Habit Tracking Log for ', '')
    # Find practiced_good_posture line
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('practiced_good_posture:'):
            value = line.split(':')[1].strip()
            habit_data.append({'date': date_str, 'good_posture': value})
            break
